diagnosis: The webhook deliveries endpoint checks organization scoping using the org.id entry from OpenTelemetry baggage. If the baggage header is absent or overridden by an attacker, the query either omits organization filtering or applies an attacker-chosen organizationId. An attacker can inspect webhook delivery bodies containing secret HMAC signatures, customer transaction payloads, and third-party webhook event data.
exploit_request:
GET /api/webhooks/whk_stripe_sync_live/deliveries HTTP/1.1
Host: webhooks.platform.io
X-API-Key: valid_partner_api_key
baggage: org.id=org_target_corp
